cards.name: Logging Boom
cards.cause: Trees are felled faster than forests can regrow.
cards.effect: Call tiles of Forest equal to the Pressure. Each called tile steps one level.

cards.surge_text: SURGE: after resolving, move the Metre 1 step toward the Skull.
cards.fact: Forests are home to 80% of amphibian species, 75% of bird species and 68% of mammal species.

metre.layout: One upright track, Trophy at the bottom, Skull at the top, 5 bands of 8 ticks (40 ticks). One sliding marker.
metre.trophy: TROPHY. The marker has slid off the bottom. Play the final lap, then count Legacy.
metre.skull: SKULL. Collapse. The planet tipped over and every Steward loses.
metre.caption: The band the marker is in is the Pressure: how many tiles each Ravage card calls.
metre.moves: Restore: down 2 ticks. Fortify: down 1 tick. Surge, Cascade, first extinction: up 8 ticks (one band).

stabilise_marker.text: STABILISED. Absorbs the next hit on this Vulnerable tile, then returns to the box.

shield_token.text: SHIELD. Absorbs the next hit on this Healthy tile.

calm_cover.text: EASY ONLY. Cover the Surge band on one random Surge card before shuffling.
